verdict.rationale: Motion ships several built-in automations that react to events (auto-reshuffling on schedule conflicts, auto-enforcing daily meeting limits, auto-moving projects when blocking tasks complete, auto-creating tasks from forwarded emails or voice, an 'AI Workflow Builder' that builds workflows from SOPs) plus a documented REST API and Zapier integration for connecting to other apps' event triggers. However, there is no first-party evidence of a user-configurable rule/event engine (e.g., webhooks or custom trigger-condition-action definitions) that an AI-native user could program directly — automation is mostly fixed, pre-built behaviors rather than user-defined rules. Missing for 10: documented webhook/event-subscription API, explicit custom rule-builder for arbitrary trigger→action logic, and independent confirmation that AI Workflow Builder supports user-defined event rules.
